caption: LUM-1298 — pi-rust TUI parity: long-paste multi-line composer (LUM-1282 F1) + /model picker open + jump-to-latest pill after detach. The terminal is 36 rows rather than the original 34 (LUM-1328 follow-up): the composer border costs the transcript two rows, and at 34 rows the /hotkeys panel's keys-section row (`PgUp/PgDn page …`) fell out of the fold. Same harness / parser / binary as LUM-1286/1293/1294.
notes: Three scenes, all on the same session: (a) idle (after startup fold), (b) long paste that wraps to multiple lines in the composer, (c) /model picker open with the head of the 27-provider list, (d) PgUp to detach viewport -> jump-to-latest pill.
No mocked rendering: real binary + real PTY + pyte VT emulator.

The /model picker scene is the new evidence for LUM-1298 — earlier rounds had /, @, /help, /hotkeys, but not the picker-driven model switch surface (which is what the upstream pi-ts TUI exposes as `/model`).

panels.label: 1. idle 120x34 after startup fold (plan_chrome reserved hint row)
2. long paste wraps into multi-line composer (LUM-1282 F1)
panels.send: Please refactor the agent_loop in pi-agent-core so that the shouldStopAfterTurn hook can be expressed as a Rust trait method and the prepareNextTurn hook can be awaited without the HRTB lifetime we hit in stage 1. Keep the wire format compatible with the upstream pi-ts TUI.

panels.label: 3. Ctrl+U clears, then /model opens the picker (real picker UI replaces the composer)
4. Esc closes picker; Ctrl+U clears; /hotkeys fills the chat so PgUp has real scrollback
5. PgUp detaches the viewport -> jump-to-latest pill appears on the last row
